Illinois Block I Americana Finale Polo

Our Price:
$74.99
Please make a selection above

Product Description

Antigua® 96% polyester/6% spandex Illinois polo. This University of Illinois polo features a crisp white base covered in an all-over festive pattern that includes fireworks, stars and celebratory icons in classic American red, white, and blue! A prominent Illinois Block I logo is embroidered on the left chest. The shirt includes a collared neckline and a button-front closure, giving it a smart-casual look suitable for game days or social events. Short sleeves provide a relaxed and breathable feel, ideal for warm weather.
